 SystemTime::now() / Instant::now() despite the Tiger Style boundaries already
 established. The web shell files are fine (they own timestamp capture), but core
 crates like seaglass-pipeline, seaglass-fileio, seaglass-transformations, and
 seaglass-ui still have them.
